    brand in China. We offer a variety of ready-to-eat, ready-to-heat,   產品品牌。我們提供即食、即熱、即煮和即
    ready-to-cook and prepared ingredients, with a focus on at-home      配食材，並專注於在家火鍋和燒烤產品。憑

    we enable consumers to enjoy meals at home with tastiness,           家中享用好吃、方便還不貴的餐食產品。憑

    retail stores, we offer a wide variety of home meal products under   家吃飯餐食產品，服務於不同的用餐場景。
    the Guoquan Shihui (鍋圈食匯) brand, serving diverse dining
    scenarios.

OUR VISION                                                         我們的願景
Our vision is to become the go-to brand for dining at home in      我們的願景是在家吃就鍋圈。
China.


OUR MISSION                                                        我們的使命
Our mission is to source quality food ingredients globally and     我們的使命是匯聚全球好食材，多場景提供
offer diverse, convenient, high-quality and value-for-money home   老百姓一站式在家吃飯「多、快、好、省」的
meal products in a one-stop shop manner to meet consumers’         餐食產品，讓偏遠鄉村的老百姓也能吃到鍋
diverse needs under different dining scenarios, from urban         圈好吃方便還不貴的好食材。
centers to the most remote areas of China.

     present arrangement will not be impaired and this structure will
     enable the Company to make and implement decisions promptly
     and effectively. The Board will continue to review and consider
     splitting the roles of chairperson of the Board and the chief
     executive officer of the Company at a time when it is appropriate
     by taking into account the circumstances of the Group as a whole.

any suspected improprieties in any matters related to the Group       疑似不當行為的任何事項，有關舉報會直接
directly addressed to the designated person.                          送交至指定人士。

                                        information, including collection, classification, identification,
                                        distribution for investigation, etc.
                                        信息保密：專人管理舉報信息，包括收集、分類、甄別、分派調查等

                                        Reporting process: After the recipient of the reported information
                                        identifies it, he or she will separately distribute it to an investigator
                                        designated by the investigation department. Upon conclusion of the
                                        investigation, the results are directly provided to the recipient of the
                                        report to proceed with the handling process. This ensures a closed-
                                        loop circulation of complaint information from reporting to resolution,
                                        safeguarding the confidentiality of the reported information and the
                                        whistleblower
                                        舉報流程：舉報信息接收人甄別後單獨分派給調查部指定調查人，調查結
                                        束後結果直接反饋至舉報接收人推進處理，形成投訴信息到查處單線閉環
                                        流轉，以保障舉報信息、舉報人保密性

                                        Whistleblower protection: The physical safety of the whistleblower
                                        is strictly protected. In cases of retaliation against the whistleblower,
                                        Guoquan Food will deal with it sternly in accordance with relevant
                                        regulations. Those suspected of illegal and criminal activities are
                                        handed over to judicial authorities for legal proceedings
                                        舉報人保護：嚴格保護舉報人人身安全。對於打擊報復舉報人的情況，鍋
                                        圈食品依照相關制度嚴肅處理，其中涉嫌違法犯罪的依法移交司法機關處

            Classification of complaints
            投訴問題分類
            •      Product, activities, personnel (service)
                   產品類投訴、活動類投訴、人員（服務）類投訴
            Risk assessment
            評估風險等級
            •      Risk levels are determined based on different types of feedback. Currently, risk levels
                   include low risk, medium risk and high risk. Initial contact timeline for complaints of each
                   risk level varies, with high-risk complaints to be handled first
                   針對不同反饋類型制定不同風險等級，目前風險等級分為低風險、中風險和高風險，各風險等級
                   對應不同的首聯時效，高風險優先聯繫處理

            •      The time limit for medium and high risk complaint handling is within 24-48 hours, with the
                   formulation of an executable and law-based handling plan
                   中高風險等級處理時效要求在24-48小時內，必須形成可執行、符合法律的處理方案
            Complaint handling requirements
            投訴處理要求
            •      For after-sales related feedback from customers, customer complaint handling personnel
                   shall conduct initial contact within 30 minutes
                   針對消費者反饋的售後問題，要求客訴人員首聯在30分鍾內完成

            •      In terms of high-risk complaints, initial contact should be made within 15 minutes to ensure
                   effective reach-out to consumers in a timely manner
                   在風險等級為高風險的情況下，首聯需在15分鍾內完成，確保第一時間與消費者建立有效聯繫

            •      For feedback submitted within 10 minutes before off-duty the day before, it should be
                   handled before 10 o’clock the next day in a timely manner
                   如在前一天下班前10分鍾內提交的問題反饋，需在次日10點之前及時聯繫處理

                 Guoquan Food and Shanghai Jiao Tong University Jointly Held CEO Workshops
                 鍋圈食品與上海交大合作開設CEO研修班
                 With the aim to improve the expertise and management capability of franchisees, Guoquan Food
                 has cooperated with Shanghai Jiao tong University and successfully held several chain CEO
                 workshops since 2022. The workshop covers multiple areas such as business model innovation,
                 public relations crisis and media response, brand strategy and omni-channel marketing, etc. It also
                 provides special training sessions on stress and emotion management and management psychology
                 to improve the comprehensive quality of franchisees.
                 為提升加盟商的專業素養和管理能力，自二零二二年起，鍋圈食品便與上海交通大學合作，成功舉辦了
                 多期連鎖CEO研修班。培訓內容涵蓋了商業模式創新、危機公關及媒體應對、品牌戰略及全渠道營銷等
                 多個方面，同時還特別設置壓力與情緒管理以及管理心理學的培訓課程，全面提升加盟商的綜合素質。
                “My Community, My Store” Franchisees Training Camp
                「我的社區我的店」加盟商研學營
                 In 2023, Guoquan Food held three training camps with the theme of “My Community, My Store” for
                 outstanding store managers. The camp provides franchisees with a comprehensive and in-depth
                 learning experience through a combination of offline courses and study tour and on-site visits.
                 The course covers practical activities such as product empowerment, sand table simulation and
                 visits to plants, aiming to improve the management capability and deepen the store managers’
                 understanding of the brand concept of Guoquan Food.
                 2023年，鍋圈食品舉辦了三期主題為「我的社區我的店」的優秀店長研學營。該研學營採用線下課程與游
                 學參訪相結合的方式，為加盟商提供了全面而深入的學習體驗。課程內容涵蓋了產品賦能、沙盤模擬以
                 及工廠探訪等實踐活動，旨在幫助店長們提升經營管理能力，加深對鍋圈食品品牌理念的理解。

                 Joined Hands with Universities to Carry Out University-enterprise Cooperation

                 Guoquan Food and China Agricultural University jointly established the Guoquan Rural
                 Revitalization Research Institute, which became the entrepreneurship internship base of the
                 College of Economics and Management of China Agricultural University, and united the upstream
                 and downstream enterprises of the supply chain to jointly build a talent cooperation platform.
                 Guoquan Food cooperated with the team led by Professor Zhang Zhenghe from China Agricultural
                 University to launch the Guoquan Rural Revitalization Empowerment Research Project, which, as a
                 key internship project for doctoral students of China Agricultural University, establishes templates
                 and cases of senior talent cultivation in the field of rural revitalization in the future.
                 鍋圈食品與中國農業大學聯合成立鍋圈鄉村振興研究院，掛牌成為中國農業大學經濟管理學院創業實習
                 基地，聯動供應鏈上下游企業共同建設人才對接平台。鍋圈食品與中國農業大學張正河教授團隊合作，
                 展開鍋圈鄉村振興賦能大調研項目，作為中國農業大學博士生重點實習項目，為未來鄉村振興領域的高
                 級人才培育輸出模板和案例。

              During the Reporting Period, Heyi Plant designed an innovative wastewater collection system, which
              collects and filters wastewater in a centralized manner for recycling for plant greening and road
              cleaning. The system is expected to save up to 6,000 cubic meters of tap water per year.
              報告期內，和一工廠創新設計了一套廢水收集系統，將廢水集中收集過濾後循環使用，用於廠區綠化和
              路面清潔，預計每年可節約高達6,000立方米的自來水。

              Optimization of Production Process
              生產流程優化
              Through refined management and technological innovation, the Wanlai Wanqu Plant has
              successfully shortened the daily operation time of the boiler and double helix at the workshop by 1.5
              hours, thereby greatly reducing energy consumption. In addition, the plant adopted a new design to
              curb the efflux of oil and water from the oil spill port, saving production water consumption by 50
              tons per day.
              丸來丸去工廠通過精細化的管理和技術創新，成功縮短了車間鍋爐及雙螺旋每日1.5小時的運行時間，從
              而大幅度降低了能源消耗。此外，工廠還採用了新的設計方案，有效遏制了溢油口的油水外排現象，使
              得每日的生產用水節約量高達50噸。
              Building of Electric Meter IoT
              電表物聯網搭建
              Heyi Plant has completely updated its IoT electric meters across the plant. Staff can view the
              daily electricity consumption in real time on the computer, easily monitor the dynamics of energy
              consumption in each time period, quickly respond to abnormal power consumption, and manage
              the factory’s electricity consumption in a refined manner.
              和一工廠在工廠範圍內全面更新了物聯網電表。工作人員在電腦上就能隨時查看每時每天的用電情況，
              輕鬆掌握各個時間段的能源消耗動態，針對異常耗電情況快速做出應對，精細化管理工廠用電情況。
              Introduction of the Automated Assembly Line
              引進自動化流水線
              In order to further improve energy efficiency, Heyi Plant has actively introduced advanced
              automated assembly line technology. Through the rolling and kneading assembly line, the
              automated packaging and palletizing equipment and automated packaging line at the workshop,
              the plant has realized automated and intelligent production process, which not only greatly
              improves the production efficiency, but also effectively reduces energy consumption and injects
              new impetus into the green development of the plant.
              為了進一步提升能源利用效率，和一工廠積極引進了先進的自動化流水線技術。通過車間滾揉流水線、
              自動包裝碼垛設備以及自動包裝線，工廠實現了生產流程的自動化和智能化，不僅大大提高了生產效
              率，還有效降低了能源消耗，為工廠的綠色發展注入了新動力。

                    Light Up 10,000 Stars in the Communities: Good Neighbors from the Dining Table to Life
                    在社區點亮一萬顆星：好鄰居從餐桌走向生活
                    We hope that Guoquan stores can help build a bridge for neighborhood communication, guard the warmth
                    with a warm heart, and become a part of consumers’ great life. At a small Guoquan store in Zhengzhou,
                    Henan Province, the owner helps the neighbor couple who are riders to take care of their child. With
                    the child as a bridge, this Guoquan store has gradually become an emotional intersection in the huge
                    community, and a mutual trust has been established from the perspective of the child. The Guoquan store
                    has planted the starlight of companionship through such simple trust. By accompanying children and the
                    whole community, the Guoquan store has become an important part of neighborhood relations.
                    我們希望鍋圈門店能助力搭建鄰里溝通的橋樑，用暖心守護溫馨，成為消費者美好生活中的一隅。在河南鄭州的
                    一家鍋圈小店，店主幫忙鄰居騎手夫妻照看孩子，以孩子為橋樑，鍋圈門店逐漸成為龐大社區裏的情感交匯點，
                    從孩子的視角出發，建立起了相互之間的信任。鍋圈小店在這樣樸實的信任中，種下了陪伴的星光，陪伴孩子，
                    陪伴整個社區，成為鄰里關係的重要部分。
                    Guoquan Food Donated Food Ingredients to the Disaster-struck Areas in Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei
                    鍋圈食品向京津冀受災地區捐贈食材
                    Due to the impact of “Doksuri”, North China suffered extremely heavy rainfall in 2023. The Group
                    immediately investigated the situation of stores in the disaster-stricken areas. On the basis of ensuring
                    community supply, Guoquan Food and Guoquan Rural Revitalization Research Institute joined hands with
                    the All-China Women’s Federation and the China Women’s Development Foundation to donate more than
                    10,000 portions of food products to the severely affected areas in Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei to support local
                    flood relief.
                    2023年，受颱風「杜蘇芮」影響，我國華北地區遭遇極端強降雨天氣。本集團第一時間摸排受災地區門店情況，
                    並在做好社區保供工作的基礎上，鍋圈食品、鍋圈鄉村振興研究院聯合全國婦聯中國婦女發展基金會，向京津冀
                    受災嚴重地區捐贈萬餘份食材，幫助當地抗汛救災。

                    Affected by the heavy rainfall, takeaway platforms received explosive orders. In order to guarantee the
                    supply of scarce food products in the absence of riders to deliver goods, the local Guoquan stores remained
                    open, and many store owners braved the rain to deliver goods like delivery riders.
                    受強降雨影響，外賣平台陸續爆單，在沒有騎手送貨的情況下，為保證緊缺食材的供應，當地鍋圈食品門店沒有
                    歇業，許多店主化身「外賣小哥」，冒雨送貨。
                    Guoquan Food Rushed to the Rescue of Gansu: Guoquan Food Donated Instant Hot Pots, Heating Pot
                    Sets and Other Materials
                    鍋圈食品馳援甘肅：捐贈速食火鍋、加熱鍋具等物資
                    On December 18, 2023, a 6.2-magnitude earthquake occurred in Jishishan County, Linxia Prefecture, Gansu
                    Province. Guoquan Food launched a disaster relief response as soon as possible, and worked together
                    with public welfare organizations to donate relief materials worth RMB530,000 to the disaster-struck
                    area. In view of the cold weather in the disaster-struck area and the damage to water, electricity and other
                    infrastructures, the donated materials were mainly portable hot pots, instant food and heating pot sets
                    that were convenient for processing and use.
                    2023年12月18日，甘肅臨夏州積石山縣發生6.2級地震。鍋圈食品第一時間啟動救災響應，聯合公益機構向災區
                    捐贈價值人民幣53萬元的救災物資。考慮到災區天氣寒冷，水、電等基礎設施受損，捐贈的物資以便於加工使用
                    的便攜火鍋、速食食品、加熱鍋具等為主。

2.4   MATERIAL ACCOUNTING POLICIES                                   2.4   重大會計政策
      Business combinations and goodwill                                   業務合併及商譽

      Business combinations are accounted for using the                    業務合併乃以收購法列賬。轉讓對價
      acquisition method. The consideration transferred is                 乃以收購日期的公允價值計量，該公
      measured at the acquisition date fair value which is                 允價值為本集團轉讓的資產於收購日
      the sum of the acquisition date fair values of assets                期的公允價值、本集團向被收購方前
      transferred by the Group, liabilities assumed by the                 擁有人承擔的負債，及本集團發行以
      Group to the former owners of the acquiree and the equity            換取被收購方控制權的股本權益的總
      interests issued by the Group in exchange for control of the         和。於各業務合併中，本集團選擇是
      acquiree. For each business combination, the Group elects            否以公允價值或被收購方可識別淨資
      whether to measure the non-controlling interests in the              產的應佔比例，計量於被收購方的非
      acquiree at fair value or at the proportionate share of the          控股權益。非控股權益的所有其他組
      acquiree’s identifiable net assets. All other components             成部分均按公允價值計量。收購相關
      of non-controlling interests are measured at fair value.             成本於產生時列為開支。
      Acquisition-related costs are expensed as incurred.


      The Group determines that it has acquired a business                 當所收購的一組活動及資產包括一項
      when the acquired set of activities and assets includes an           資源投入及一項實質過程，而兩者對
      input and a substantive process that together significantly          創造產出的能力有重大貢獻時，本集
      contribute to the ability to create outputs.                         團釐定其已收購一項業務。

      2.4   MATERIAL ACCOUNTING POLICIES                                     2.4   重大會計政策（續）
            (CONTINUED)
            When the Group acquires a business, it assesses the                    當本集團收購一項業務時，會根據合
            financial assets and liabilities assumed for appropriate               約條款、於收購日期的經濟環境及相
            classification and designation in accordance with the                  關條件，評估須承擔的金融資產及負
            contractual terms, economic circumstances and pertinent                債，以作出適合的分類及標示，其中
            conditions as at the acquisition date. This includes the               包括將被收購方主合約中的嵌入式衍
            separation of embedded derivatives in host contracts of                生工具進行分離。
            the acquiree.


            If the business combination is achieved in stages, the                 倘業務合併分階段進行，先前持有的
            previously held equity interest is remeasured at its                   股本權益按其於收購日期的公允價值
            acquisition date fair value and any resulting gain or loss is          重新計量，產生的任何損益在損益中
            recognised in profit or loss.                                          確認。


            Any contingent consideration to be transferred by the                  收購方將予轉讓的任何或然代價於收
            acquirer is recognised at fair value at the acquisition                購日期按公允價值確認。分類為資產
            date. Contingent consideration classified as an asset or               或負債的或然代價按公允價值計量，
            liability is measured at fair value with changes in fair value         公允價值變動於損益中確認。分類為
            recognised in profit or loss. Contingent consideration that            權益的或有代價不會重新計量，其後
            is classified as equity is not remeasured and subsequent               結算於權益內入賬。
            settlement is accounted for within equity.


            Goodwill is initially measured at cost, being the excess               商譽初始按成本計量，即所轉讓對
            of the aggregate of the consideration transferred, the                 價、就非控股權益確認的金額及本集
            amount recognised for non-controlling interests and any                團先前持有的被收購方股權的任何公
            fair value of the Group’s previously held equity interests             允價值總計超過所收購可識別資產及
            in the acquiree over the identifiable assets acquired and              所承擔負債的差額。倘該對價及其他
            liabilities assumed. If the sum of this consideration and              項目之和低於所收購資產淨值的公允

            Fair value measurement                                                  公允價值計量

            The Group measures its certain financial assets and equity              本集團於報告期末按公允價值計量其
            investments at fair value at the end of the reporting period.           若干金融資產和股權投資。公允價值
            Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an               為市場參與者於計量日期在有序交易
            asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction         中出售資產所收取的價格或轉讓負債
            between market participants at the measurement date.                    所支付的價格。公允價值計量乃根據
            The fair value measurement is based on the presumption                  假設出售資產或轉讓負債的交易於資
            that the transaction to sell the asset or transfer the                  產或負債主要市場或（在無主要市場
            liability takes place either in the principal market for the            情況下）最具優勢市場進行而作出。
            asset or liability, or in the absence of a principal market,            主要或最具優勢市場須為本集團可進
            in the most advantageous market for the asset or liability.             入的市場。資產或負債的公允價值乃
            The principal or the most advantageous market must be                   按假設市場參與者於資產或負債定價
            accessible by the Group. The fair value of an asset or a                時會以最佳經濟利益行事計量。
            liability is measured using the assumptions that market
            participants would use when pricing the asset or liability,
            assuming that market participants act in their economic
            best interest.


            A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes                 非金融資產的公允價值計量計及市場
            into account a market participant’s ability to generate                 參與者能最大限度使用該資產達致最
            economic benefits by using the asset in its highest and                 佳用途，或將該資產出售予將最大限
            best use or by selling it to another market participant that            度使用該資產達致最佳用途的其他市
            would use the asset in its highest and best use.                        場參與者，所產生的經濟效益。


            The Group uses valuation techniques that are appropriate                本集團採納適用於不同情況且具備充
            in the circumstances and for which sufficient data are                  分數據以供計量公允價值的估值方
            available to measure fair value, maximising the use of                  法，以盡量使用相關可觀察輸入數據
            relevant observable inputs and minimising the use of                    及盡量減少使用不可觀察輸入數據。
            unobservable inputs.

            General approach                                                      一般法

            ECLs are recognised in two stages. For credit exposures for           預期信貸虧損分兩個階段進行確認。
            which there has not been a significant increase in credit             就自初步確認起未有顯著增加的信貸
            risk since initial recognition, ECLs are provided for credit          風險而言，預期信貸虧損提供予由未
            losses that result from default events that are possible              來12個月內可能發生違約事件而導致
            within the next 12 months (a 12-month ECL). For those                 的信貸虧損（12個月預期信貸虧損）。
            credit exposures for which there has been a significant               就自初步確認起經已顯著增加的信貸
            increase in credit risk since initial recognition, a loss             風險而言，不論何時發生違約，於餘
            allowance is required for credit losses expected over the             下風險年期內的預期信貸虧損均須計
            remaining life of the exposure, irrespective of the timing of         提虧損準備（年限內預期信貸虧損）。
            the default (a lifetime ECL).

            the credit risk on a financial instrument has increased               認起金融工具的信貸風險是否顯著

            date with the risk of a default occurring on the financial            險，同時考慮無需沒有過多的成本和
            instrument as at the date of initial recognition and                  努力即可獲得的合理的和可支持的信
            considers reasonable and supportable information that is              息，包括歷史和前瞻性信息。本集團
            available without undue cost or effort, including historical          認為，當合同付款逾期超過30天時，
            and forward-looking information. The Group considers that             信貸風險會顯著增加。
            there has been a significant increase in credit risk when
            contractual payments are more than 30 days past due.

            contractual payments are 90 days past due. However, in                慮違約的金融資產。然而，在某些情

            simplified approach, the Group does not track changes               風險的變化，而是在每個報告日期確

      Derecognition of financial liabilities                                 終止確認金融負債

      from the same lender on substantially different terms,                 方按完全不同之條款提供負債取代，

      modified, such an exchange or modification is treated as               上述取代或修訂視為終止確認原有負
      a derecognition of the original liability and a recognition of         債及確認新負債，而相關賬面值之差
      a new liability, and the difference between the respective             額在損益表確認。
      carrying amounts is recognised in the statement of profit
      or loss.

      goods, comprises direct materials, direct labour and an                直接材料、直接勞工及適當比例的間
      appropriate proportion of overheads. Net realisable value              接成本。可變現淨值按估計售價減完
      is based on estimated selling prices less any estimated                成及出售將產生的任何估計成本計算。
      costs to be incurred to completion and disposal.

      within three months when acquired, less bank overdrafts                三個月內到期），並已減去須按要求償

            to be required to settle the obligation. The increase in the         產生的貼現現值增加部分，列作財務

40.   FINANCIAL RISK MANAGEMENT OBJECTIVES                             40.   財務風險管理目標及政策
      AND POLICIES
      The Group’s principal financial instruments comprise bank              本集團的主要金融工具包括銀行及其
      and other interest-bearing borrowings, long-term bank                  他計息借款、長期銀行存款以及現金
      deposits and cash and bank balances. The main purpose                  及銀行結餘。該等金融工具的主要目
      of these financial instruments is to raise finance for the             的是為本集團的營運籌集資金。本集
      Group’s operations. The Group has various other financial              團有多項其他金融資產及負債，如直
      assets and liabilities such as trade receivables and trade             接自其營運產生的貿易應收款項及貿
      payables, which arise directly from its operations.                    易應付款項。


      The main risks arising from the Group’s financial                      本集團金融工具產生的主要風險為外
      instruments are foreign currency risk, interest rate risk,             幣風險、利率風險、信貸風險及流動
      credit risk and liquidity risk. The board of directors reviews         資金風險。董事會審閱及同意管理該

      Capital management                                                  資本管理

      The primary objectives of the Group’s capital management            本集團資本管理的主要目標是維護本
      are to safeguard the Group’s ability to continue as a going         集團的持續經營能力及維持穩健資本
      concern and to maintain healthy capital ratios in order to          充足率以支持業務發展及實現權益持
      support its business and maximise equity holders’ value.            有人價值最大化。


      The Group manages its capital structure and makes                   本集團會根據經濟狀況變化和相關資
      adjustments to it in light of changes in economic                   產的風險特徵管理或調整資本結構。
      conditions and the risk characteristics of the underlying           為維持或調整資本結構，本集團會調
      assets. To maintain or adjust the capital structure, the            整派發予權益持有人的股息、返還股
      Group may adjust the dividend payment to equity holders,            本予權益持有人或發行新股。本集團
      return capital to equity holders or issue new shares. The           並無受到任何外部資本需求的約束。
      Group is not subject to any externally imposed capital              於截至二零二三年十二月三十一日及
      requirements. No changes were made in the objectives,               二零二二年十二月三十一日止年度，
      policies or processes for managing capital during the years         本集團並無對資本管理的目標、政策
      ended 31 December 2023 and 31 December 2022.                        或程序作出變動。


      The Group monitors capital using a gearing ratio, which             本集團使用資產負債比率監控資本，
      is debt divided by the adjusted capital plus debt. Debt             資產負債比率為負債除以經調整資
      includes interest-bearing borrowings and lease liabilities.         本加上負債。負債包括計息借款和租
      Capital represents equity attributable to owners of the             賃負債。資本指母公司擁有人應佔權
